title: New colour picker grid glow effect creates bad contrast

judgment.rationale: The reporter describes a newly bright grid treatment that makes fine boundaries hard to see and supplies a screenshot. The pinned Color Picker editor has a color-matched selected-swatch stroke, but the screenshot's exact control and cause have not been independently confirmed.
evidence: The reporter says the new grid glow makes low-contrast items and thin outlines hard to see.
The issue includes a public screenshot and was reported on 0.102.3101.

The issue description provides the affected version, visual symptom, expected contrast behavior, and a public screenshot: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b992fcf1-1969-4d2c-93a5-1ff8759a3434

The editor defines a color-matched selected swatch stroke in its custom ListViewItem template. Source at pinned main (237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c): https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/ColorPicker/ColorPickerUI/Views/ColorEditorView.xaml

The Color Picker overlay is a separate surface; the report's screenshot must be matched to the responsible view before changing visuals. Source at pinned main (237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c): https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/modules/ColorPicker/ColorPickerUI/Views/ColorPickerView.xaml
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the issue-specific scenario: Restore contrast around Color Picker grid selections

fix_assessment.rationale: The visual adjustment should follow a maintainer reproduction that identifies whether the contrast loss comes from the Color Picker selection stroke, focus treatment, or another surface.

proposed_fixes.title: Restore contrast around Color Picker grid selections
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a recent Color Picker grid/selection visual treatment uses a bright glow or color-matched outline that obscures adjacent low-contrast boundaries.
plan: Reproduce the reported low-contrast case and identify which Color Picker surface owns the bright treatment.
If the selection stroke/glow is confirmed, reduce or constrain its intensity and retain a clear non-color-dependent focus indicator.
Add a visual/accessibility regression with adjacent low-contrast edges and both light/dark themes.
verification: The edge of the reported checkbox and other thin boundaries remain distinguishable while a color is selected.
Selected and unselected swatches remain identifiable in light and dark themes.

reproduce.title: Restore contrast around Color Picker grid selections
prerequisites: PowerToys Color Picker enabled on Windows.
Use the same theme and display scaling as the report if known.
steps: Open the Color Picker UI and navigate to the grid/selection surface shown in the issue attachment.
Select colors adjacent to a low-contrast boundary, including the reported checkbox/outline case.
Compare the selected and unselected boundary visibility in light and dark themes.
reproduce.expected_result: The selected color is distinguishable without obscuring adjacent thin boundaries or low-contrast outlines.
